summary: January 2026 salary not received. 3 weeks overdue.
details: Worker reported that her January 2026 salary of AED 1,200 has not been paid. Employer claims bank processing delay. Worker has been waiting 3 weeks. Needs urgent follow-up.
adminNotes: Contacted employer. Awaiting confirmation of payment release.

summary: Workplace injury — scaffolding fall. Currently hospitalized.
details: Worker sustained injuries from a scaffolding fall at the Doha Engineering site. Currently admitted at Hamad General Hospital, Qatar. OWWA and Philippine Embassy have been notified. Employer has provided initial medical coverage.
adminNotes: OWWA Qatar Desk contacted. Coordinating with employer for insurance claim. Family in Philippines informed.
